subject: Converged controls review + pen-test preflight — slot proposal and logistics
messages:
From: Tim Hart <tim.hart@starlend.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@starlend.com
Date: Mon, 25 Sep 2028 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Requesting a short converged review (SOC2 + pen preflight)

Hi Markus,

We’re preparing for our upcoming SOC2 Type II assessment and coordinating a third-party pen test next month. Rather than separate calls, our security team would like a compact session to align on controls mapping, evidence hand-off, and the pen-test logistics (30	60 minutes).

Quick context:
- Company: StarLend (fintech).
- What we need from Redwood: confirmation of evidence access method, expected artifact names/paths, and any staging access requirements for the pen vendor.
- Pen vendor: VulnCheck (we can loop them in if helpful).

Would you have any 45-minute slots next week PST mornings (10:00 AM PST onward)? Our core attendees would be me and our security engineer (security@starlend.com); vendor may join for the second half.

Appreciate a couple options and whether you prefer a single 45-min call or split 30/30 (controls vs. vendor logistics).

Thanks,
Tim Hart
Head of InfoSec
StarLend

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tim Hart <tim.hart@starlend.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Sep 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Requesting a short converged review (SOC2 + pen preflight)

On Mon, 25 Sep 2028 at 14:03, Tim Hart <tim.hart@starlend.com> wrote:
> We’re preparing for our upcoming SOC2 Type II assessment and coordinating a third-party pen test next month. Rather than separate calls, our security team would like a compact session to align on controls mapping, evidence hand-off, and the pen-test logistics (30	60 minutes).
>
Thanks for the context, Tim. We can absolutely run a compact session that covers both controls mapping and pen-test logistics. Two quick proposals so we can land a calendar invite that meets your flow: 

Option A (single meeting): 45 minutes total
- 00-25m: controls + evidence mapping (SOC2 scope)
- 25-45m: pen-test logistics + staging access (vendor can join)

Option B (split): 30m controls handoff (internal), 30m vendor handoff (separate invite)

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue Oct 3, 2028 10:00 AM
- Tue Oct 3, 2028 11:30 AM
- Wed Oct 4, 2028 09:00 AM

A couple items for prep so we can be efficient on the call:
- Can you confirm the pen vendor contact (email) and whether they require ephemeral SSH keys or a VPN jump host?
- If you can attach an initial evidence snapshot (list of artifact file names/paths), we’ll pre-map responsible Redwood owners. I’m attaching our evidence-template so you can drop examples in.

[Attachment: redwood-evidence-template.xlsx (Spreadsheet, 38KB)]

Kimberly, Ben 	6 pinging you both to help with scheduling and to confirm who from ops should join for staging access notes.

Markus Klein
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 27 Sep 2028 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: StarLend converged call coordination (quick)

Kimberly / Ben,

Quick internal note while we wait for confirmation from Tim:
- Please block Tue Oct 3, 2028 10:00-10:50 AM PDT as tentative on my calendar (we can adjust).
- Kimberly: can you pre-populate the evidence-template with likely Redwood artifact owners and S3 paths (app logs, audit trails, retention policies)? Aim for a 24-hour turnaround.
- Ben: please draft a short ops checklist for vendor onboarding (VPN vs ephemeral keys, required DB read-only creds, IP allowlist windows). If we split the session, you should own the vendor handoff slot and invite VulnCheck.

Also, note that some customers prefer a single meeting to reduce context switching; others prefer split sessions to keep the vendor and compliance SMEs focused. I’ll defer to your availability but want to be ready to send the final invite once Tim confirms.

Thanks,
Markus

From: Tim Hart <tim.hart@starlend.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@starlend.com, VulnCheck Ops <ops@vulncheck.co>
Date: Sat, 30 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Requesting a short converged review (SOC2 + pen preflight)

Markus,

Thanks 	6 that looks good. Let’s take Option A (single 45-minute meeting). We can have VulnCheck join for the back half. Confirmed slot: Tue Oct 3, 2028 10:00 AM PDT (I’m in PST). Please send a calendar invite and include dial-in + Redwood staging contact.

Pen vendor contact: ops@vulncheck.co (ops is the primary onboarding alias). They use ephemeral SSH and will request an allowlist window; they’ll coordinate exact IPs after the invite.

Attached is a short evidence snapshot to get you started. It includes high-level artifact names and the path where they live. We don’t need full files yet, just the mapping so your team can prep owners.

[Attachment: starlend-evidence-snapshot.pdf (PDF, 210KB)]

See you Tue.

Best,
Tim Hart
Head of InfoSec, StarLend
